author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am prepared to accept a manual review step for every model evaluation before we push it to the registry. I know this slows down our weekly retraining cycle and adds friction to the deployment pipeline. I am willing to give up the speed of fully automated promotion allocation sizing in exchange for the certainty that every model we serve has been thoroughly checked by a human. If we keep the evaluation manual, I can live with a longer lead time for new models to reach the stores. I will not fight for a fully automated registry if it means skipping the documented sign off on the metrics. I accept the slower pace because I value the traceability of a verified model over the convenience of an unverified one.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the speed and convenience of automated deployment in exchange for the certainty and traceability provided by manual human review.
